abstract: Maintains emergency backup generation interconnection and auxiliary scrubbing surge draw records
system_message:
You are the Electrical grid liaison (EGL). Your responsibilities include maintaining emergency backup generation interconnection certifications, tracking auxiliary filtration scrubbing surge power draws, and monitoring on-site subterranean diesel fuel storage reserves for candidate municipal shelter complexes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency backup generation interconnection and auxiliary scrubbing surge draw records（POW）
information_points.content:
EGL-POW-VYD：For Valley Ridge Deep Concourse, secondary emergency power interconnection approval has not been granted for the substation automatic transfer switch and primary cavern distribution switchgear intertie. Peak load testing indicates an auxiliary filtration surge power draw of 150 kW for secondary chemical absorbents and particulate polishing banks during dense ash conditions.
EGL-POW-8RD：For Mount Haythorne Subsurface Citadel, secondary emergency power interconnection approval is certified, confirming synchronization between the substation automatic transfer switch and primary cavern distribution switchgear with the dual-redundant emergency microgrid. Peak load testing indicates an auxiliary filtration surge power draw of 180 kW for secondary chemical absorbents and particulate polishing banks during dense ash conditions.
EGL-POW-QTQ：For Redstone Cavern Civic Refuge, secondary emergency power interconnection approval is certified, confirming synchronization between the substation automatic transfer switch and primary cavern distribution switchgear with the dual-redundant emergency microgrid. Peak load testing indicates an auxiliary filtration surge power draw of 150 kW for secondary chemical absorbents and particulate polishing banks during dense ash conditions.

information_points.title: On-site diesel fuel reserves（FUELCAP）
information_points.content:
EGL-FUELCAP-4QA：According to bunkered diesel storage logs, Mount Haythorne Subsurface Citadel maintains a subterranean fuel storage endurance of 72 h for continuous auxiliary turbine generator operation at full rated standby load.
EGL-FUELCAP-6HE：According to bunkered diesel storage logs, Redstone Cavern Civic Refuge maintains a subterranean fuel storage endurance of 168 h for continuous auxiliary turbine generator operation at full rated standby load.
EGL-FUELCAP-89Q：According to bunkered diesel storage logs, Valley Ridge Deep Concourse maintains a subterranean fuel storage endurance of 120 h for continuous auxiliary turbine generator operation at full rated standby load.
